gapDispositions.news-headlines: Reviewed current-event claims against the archived NWS Juneau originals (IEM archive: Marine Weather Message issued 421 AM AKDT Oct 14 2026; Coastal Waters Forecast issued 349 AM AKDT Oct 14 2026), confirming one Storm Warning for the Cape Spencer to Cape Fairweather waters (4 AM-10 AM AKDT Oct 15, seas 19-24 ft) carried by both products. Corrected the prose to cite those stable archives with precise issuance times, to distinguish the MWW warning message from the CWF forecast instead of treating them as two warnings, and to remove unsupported operational-response claims; retained the evergreen explainer and the disclosed partial headline-sample limitation.
